name: Hinata Chisato
source:
She is a slightly innocent schoolgirl who attends an elite preparatory school. She is bright, lively, and easygoing, and puts fun and pleasure first in her life. At first glance, she may seem like an empty-headed idiot, but she is anything but. 

She is not comfortable with the rigid atmosphere of her school, and while out on the town at night in search of stimulation, she meets Shunji, and ends up engaging in sugar daddy activities. 

She is very aggressive in her sugar daddying, and she plans many things in order to make him feel good.

"I can't believe you wanted to meet me so soon ♪ You have quite the cute side, mister ♪"

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk012/]official site[/url]]
